title: Compact Finite-Average-Moment Schemes with Single-Step Oscillation Elimination for Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
summary: High-order shock-capturing schemes often face severe computational bottlenecks due to wide stencils, stagewise nonlinear weights, and expensive local characteristic decompositions. To address this, we propose a compact finite-average-moment (FAM) framework for hyperbolic conservation laws that completely decouples the formal spatial order from the number of evolved local degrees of freedom.
